title: TRICARE Select Exits, Proration Credits and Refunds of Enrollment Fees
content:
**Provision.** When a fee-bearing **TRICARE Select** enrollment ends for a reason in the tier's credit-earning exit reasons, the paid fee for every whole calendar month after the disenrollment date is credited at one twelfth of the annual fee per month; the month containing the disenrollment date is never credited and a nonpayment disenrollment earns no credit. A credit is posted only against an installment charge that has a payment posted against it. A resulting credit balance is refunded through the original payment method within the tier's refund period. A voluntary disenrollment needs the beneficiary's own confirmation - the agent records the request as an intake and the beneficiary confirms it - and takes effect on the date confirmed, never earlier. A move outside the West Region transfers the enrollment to the gaining region, carrying the family accumulators; a move inside the region changes nothing for Select.

## Credit amount

The credit is the number of credited months - the whole calendar months after the disenrollment date inside the paid installment's coverage period - multiplied by the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (individual or family) and divided by 12, rounded to the cent.

## Worked credit (hypothetical)

A family on TRICARE Select Retiree Group A (family annual fee 396.00) paid the annual installment for the 2026 calendar year and disenrolls voluntarily on 2026-08-14. August is not credited; September through December are four whole months: 4 multiplied by 396.00 and divided by 12 gives a credit of 132.00, posted against the paid annual installment.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Credit |
|---|---|
| disenrollment for a credit-earning reason, installment paid | whole months after the disenrollment month, at one twelfth of the annual fee each |
| nonpayment disenrollment | none |
| installment charge with no payment posted against it | no credit is posted against it |
| move inside the West Region | nothing changes for Select |
